items.question: Does the UAE permit expatriate residents to build and run their own places of worship?
items.gold: Yes, the UAE has permitted the construction and running of places of worship for expatriate residents.
items.fact: UAE permits expatriate residents' places of worship construction and running

items.question: Which types of places of worship for expatriate residents does the UAE permit under its tolerance policy regarding religious freedom?
items.fact: UAE permits temples, churches and gurdwara for expatriates
